title: 第十七章 草木洗经二第十八章 师兄的路
content_zh:
待得季军师出去后，李言顿觉体内气息一畅，不由的苦笑一声，只要老师站在身边，他就会觉得气息受滞。
当下，他宁神静气，不再多想！
之前季军师就告诉过他，这铜炉每次燃烧大约有一个时辰的时间来让他修炼，他可不能耽误时间。
快步走到铜炉前，立了个桩姿后，李言将双手伸到那铜盆之上的青黑气之中，同时默运口诀心法。
顿时那些包裹于双手之外的青黑之气像是受了牵引一般，分成十缕黑丝向其指尖一钻而去。
李言顿觉得有一根根像是烧红的尖针，忽地一下撬开了他的指甲，如同要将其生生剥离一般，那股疼痛直刺心脏和大脑。
即使是李言心里早有准备，但也未料到有如此痛楚，他当下闷哼一声，脚下桩步摇晃了几下，身形更是后退了两步。
而古怪的一幕就发生了，青黑细丝之气竟兀自不散，随着他的后退而拉长，仿佛受功法牵引一般，依旧拼命向着指甲缝内钻去。
李言身上黑袍瞬间就被汗水浸透，当下一咬牙，强凝心神中又向前移了两步，重新站定桩姿。
同时他的体内，一缕缕青黑细丝之气犹如烧红的银针，在他的经脉中不断穿刺、前进。
每前进一寸，他的浑身都不自觉地战栗一下，汗水一层层如浆般涌出。
他不知道自己能坚持修炼多久，但他性格天生坚韧，认准之事，虽不能做得尽善尽美，却总是竭尽全力而为之。
时间一点点流逝，待到得后来，李言神经早已麻木，只有脑海中还下意识的运转功法，催动那些青黑之气在体内游走。
室外，盘坐于石桌之上的季军师虽然闭目打坐，却偶尔眼皮抖动，暴露出了他的不安。
直至半个多时辰后，他忽地眼睛猛地一睁，人瞬间就已从石桌上消失，李言房屋大门同时被一股无形之力打开。
室内的李言此刻面容青黑，双手至双臂布满了一层黑气，他这时已无知觉，连最后下意识运转功法都已经无法做到了。
他的身体正向后仰去，那些青黑之气依旧死死的连着他的十指，随着他身体向后倒去，就形成了一道道弧线之状，看上去甚是诡异。
而就在他后仰之中便要直挺挺摔倒在地时，一道身影已赫然已来到他的身后，一只大袖一拂一卷中，就将他托在了半空。
同时，另一只大袖则对着那十道青黑之气一抖，只听轻微“波波”几声，如同利刃切割一般，那些古怪青黑之气才从李言十指上断了开来。
但李言身体仿佛仍有吸力般似的，那些断开的青黑之气在空中仍如扭动的毒蛇，向李言身体方向吐吞摇摆不亦，显得可怖诡异之极。

季军师对那些青黑之气则不再看一上眼，卷着李言的大袖一抖，一股平和之力托着李言飞向木床，将其缓缓放在了床上。
随后他几步来到床前，双手在胸前飞舞，结了几个看上去有些复杂的手印后，指尖上竟然飞出几点青色星芒，然后就落向李言的腹部。
李言正恍若置身在火山之中，只感觉身体灼痛难忍，想叫却又无法叫出口，煎熬无比。
无数赤红的岩浆包围着他，正在将他不断的烧熟煮透，李言只觉得自己是要死在这火山之中了。
突然一股清凉之意在他腹部升起，炙热难耐的火山与那无边的岩浆随之快速退去，脑中顷刻间也变得清明起来。
待得他睁开双眼，发现自己正平躺在床上，床边站着一身黑袍的季军师，他不由想挣扎坐起，可胸腹之处又是一阵刺热剧痛。
他不由地重重“哼”了一声，一下又摔躺了下去，顿觉得眼前一阵火星乱冒，身体中那火山隐隐又有发作之势。
定了定神后，他扭头看向季军师勉强一笑。
“老.老师，弟子无能，愧对恩师期望……”
“呵呵呵……你不必自责，第一次就能坚持半个时辰以上，已令为师大感意外，你做得很好了。”
季军师对他温和一笑。
“这……这么说，弟子算是可以修炼本门功法了！”
李言面部有些扭曲，口中艰难的说道。
“这是自然！不过，你现在虽然难受，但还是要把刚刚吸收的草木药力炼化了，不然这些药力停留在你身体内，可是百害而无一利的。
并且只有炼化后，这些药力才属于你自身，才算完成一轮修炼。”
李言自然知道这些，这些在之前季军师就已说过。
每一次修炼分两步：吸收草木药力；运转内力炼化。
七七四十九日之后，即可达到第一层，体内就会产生真正内力，而非现在的那股凉意，以后身体以此为基础，不用再吸收草木药力，通过不断修炼即可。
content_en:
After Master Ji went out, Li Yan suddenly felt his breath became smoother and couldn't help but smile bitterly. As long as the teacher was standing next to him, he would feel his breath stagnation.
At the moment, he was calm and didn't think about it anymore!
Master Ji had told him before that each time the copper furnace burned, it would take about an hour for him to practice, and he couldn't waste time.
Quickly walking to the copper stove and standing in a stance, Li Yan stretched his hands into the green and black air above the copper basin while silently practicing the formula.
Suddenly, the green and black energy wrapped around his hands seemed to be pulled, split into ten strands of black strands and went towards his fingertips.
Li Yanden felt like there were sharp red-hot needles, suddenly prying open his nails, as if they were about to be peeled off, and the pain pierced his heart and brain.
Even though Li Yan was prepared, he didn't expect such pain. He groaned, swayed a few times, and took two steps back.
And a strange scene happened. The green and black filaments of Qi lingered on, stretching as he retreated. As if being pulled by the technique, they still tried their best to drill into the gaps between his nails.
Li Yan's black robe was soaked with sweat in an instant. He gritted his teeth, concentrated his mind, and moved two steps forward to regain his stance.
At the same time, in his body, wisps of blue and black filaments of Qi were like red-hot silver needles, constantly piercing and advancing in his meridians.
With every inch he advanced, his whole body trembled unconsciously, and sweat poured out in layers.
He didn't know how long he could persist in practicing, but he was born with a tenacious character. Even if he couldn't do the things he was determined to do perfectly, he would always try his best to do it.
Time passed little by little, and by the time he arrived, Li Yan's nerves had long been numb, and he could only subconsciously run the skills in his mind, urging the green and black energy to swim in his body.
Outdoors, Ji Junshi was sitting cross-legged on the stone table. Although he was meditating with his eyes closed, his eyelids occasionally twitched, revealing his uneasiness.
More than half an hour later, his eyes suddenly opened. He disappeared from the stone table in an instant, and the door of Li Yan's house was opened by an invisible force at the same time.
Li Yan's face in the room was now black and black, and his hands and arms were covered with a layer of black energy. He was unconscious at this time and could no longer even subconsciously operate the skills.
His body was leaning back, and the green and black energy was still tightly connected to his fingers. As his body fell backward, it formed arcs, which looked very strange.
And just when he was leaning back and about to fall straight to the ground, a figure suddenly came behind him, and a big sleeve was rolled up and held him up in the air.
At the same time, the other sleeve shook at the ten green and black Qi. Only after hearing a few slight "bop" sounds, like cutting with a sharp blade, did those strange green and black Qi break off from Li Yan's ten fingers.
But Li Yan's body seemed to still have suction, and the disconnected green and black energy was still like a twisting poisonous snake in the air, spitting and swaying in the direction of Li Yan's body, looking extremely terrifying and weird.
Master Ji no longer looked at those green and black auras. He rolled up Li Yan's sleeves and shook them. A gentle force carried Li Yan to fly to the wooden bed and slowly placed him on the bed.
Then he came to the bed in a few steps, his hands flying in front of his chest, and after forming a few complicated-looking hand seals, a few blue stars flew out from his fingertips, and then fell towards Li Yan's abdomen.
Li Yanzheng felt as if he was in a volcano. He felt unbearable burning pain in his body. He wanted to scream but couldn't. It was extremely painful.
Countless red magma surrounded him and was cooking him thoroughly. Li Yan felt that he was going to die in this volcano.
Suddenly, a cool feeling rose in his abdomen. The unbearably hot volcano and the boundless magma quickly receded, and his mind suddenly became clear.
Wait until he opens his eyes, he found himself lying flat on the bed, with Ji Junshi in black robe standing next to the bed. He couldn't help but want to struggle to sit up, but there was another stinging pain in his chest and abdomen.
He couldn't help but let out a loud "hum" and fell down again. Suddenly he felt sparks rising in front of his eyes, and the volcano in his body had a faint tendency to explode again.
After regaining his composure, he turned to look at Master Ji and forced a smile.
"Old teacher, my disciple is incompetent and I am ashamed of my expectations of my teacher..."
"Hehehe... You don't have to blame yourself. You were able to hold on for more than half an hour for the first time, which surprised me. You did a great job."
The third division commander smiled gently at him.
"This...so this disciple can practice his own technique!"
Li Yan's face was a little distorted and he spoke with difficulty.
"This is natural! However, even though you feel uncomfortable now, you still need to refine the medicinal power of the plants and trees you just absorbed. Otherwise, these medicinal powers will remain in your body and do no good.
And only after refining, these medicinal powers belong to you, and you have completed a round of practice. "
Li Yan naturally knew this, as Master Ji had already said this before.
Each practice is divided into two steps: absorbing the medicinal power of plants and trees; and using internal energy to refine.
After seventy-seven forty-nine days, the first level will be reached, and the body will generate real internal power instead of the current coolness. From now on, the body will use this as the basis, and will no longer need to absorb the power of herbs and medicines, just through continuous practice.
